drivers.title: Strong jobs report lifts hike odds
drivers.text: October payrolls rose 165,000 against a 48,000 average monthly gain over the prior year, and unemployment was 4.1%. The 10-year ended Friday at 4.86% and Investing.com shows a 9 Dec hike at about 81% on Monday morning.

drivers.title: Oil's worst week since 2020
drivers.text: Brent was on track to fall about 16% and WTI about 13% on the week on hopes the midterm results ease the Iran war. Tanker attacks near Hormuz limited the drop.

sowhat.text: A strong labor market keeps financing costly, with the 10-year at 4.86% and a December hike about 81% priced. Power and energy asset sales are active (NRG/LS Power, CVR/Marathon), while the AI selloff leaves stock-funded tech deals like Marvell/Lumentum exposed to share-price swings.

pitch: Friday was calmer after Thursday's rout, but the Nasdaq is now in a correction. The S&P 500 rose 0.3 percent to about 7,377 and the Nasdaq gained 1.1 percent as AI names bounced, but for the week the S&P is down 2.7 percent. The jobs report was strong, 165,000 new jobs and unemployment at 4.1 percent, so the 10-year rose to 4.86 percent and a December Fed hike is priced at about 81 percent. Oil had its worst week since 2020, with Brent near 98 dollars and WTI near 91, on hopes of an Iran deal after the midterms. On deals, Marvell's roughly 115 billion dollar stock deal for Lumentum is the big one, and in energy NRG agreed this morning to sell six gas plants to LS Power for 4 billion dollars, and CVR is buying two Marathon refineries for about 4.2 billion.

quiz.q: What was the October payroll gain reported on Friday 6 Nov?
Why did oil fall about 13 to 16% over the week ended 6 Nov?
quiz.a: Midterm losses for the Republican Party raised hopes the Iran war would de-escalate, which could free up more Gulf crude. Weak tech stocks also weighed.

quiz.q: Who advised CVR Energy on its purchase of two Marathon refineries, and for about how much?
quiz.a: Barclays was CVR's exclusive financial adviser; the price is about $4.2B plus working capital.

chat.a: Friday was calmer after Thursday's AI rout: the S&P 500 rose 0.3% to 7,377 and the Nasdaq 1.1%, but the S&P is down 2.7% on the week. A strong jobs report pushed the 10-year to 4.86%. Oil had its steepest weekly fall since 2020.
chat.tip: Lead with the week, then the jobs report.

chat.q: What's your read on oil this week?
chat.a: WTI settled at $90.83 and Brent at $98.32, and Reuters had them on track for weekly drops of about 13% and 16%. Traders bet the midterm results make an Iran deal more likely, but tanker attacks near Hormuz keep a risk premium in. For energy M&A, a lower and more volatile price makes buyers and sellers harder to match.
chat.tip: Name the Iran deal hope and the Hormuz risk.

chat.a: Marvell's roughly $115B all-stock purchase of Lumentum, with Qatalyst, J.P. Morgan and Goldman for Marvell and Citi and Evercore for Lumentum. This morning NRG agreed to sell six gas plants to LS Power for $4B cash with Barclays advising. In energy also, CVR is buying two Marathon refineries for about $4.2B with Barclays advising, and DTE agreed to sell DTE Vantage for about $2.97B.
chat.tip: Name the advisers; bankers will ask.

chat.q: What are you watching this week?
chat.a: October CPI on Tuesday 10 Nov, since the jobs beat already put a December hike near 81%. Treasuries are closed Wednesday for Veterans Day, and PPI comes Friday. I'm also watching whether AI stocks hold their bounce, with the VIX at 25.64.
chat.tip: Tie CPI to the Fed hike odds.

chat.q: If the 10-year rose 50 bp, what happens to a DCF?
chat.a: The 10-year is 4.86% now. A 50 bp rise lifts the risk-free rate and so the WACC, which lowers the present value of cash flows. Companies with most of their value in the terminal value, like growth tech, fall the most.
chat.tip: Say the direction, then who is hit hardest.

chat.q: How does a falling acquirer share price affect a stock deal like Marvell and Lumentum?
chat.a: Marvell is paying 4.5 of its shares per Lumentum share, a premium of about 24% to 28 Oct prices. The ratio is fixed, so a lower Marvell share price cuts the dollar value Lumentum holders receive, while the premium was set against old prices. Boards may face pressure to revisit terms if the gap widens.

chat.q: How do the Fed and the 10-year affect M&A financing right now?
chat.a: The Fed range is 3.75–4.00% after a 25 bp hike in September, and a December hike is priced at about 81%. The 10-year is 4.86%, so debt is costly. High yield spreads were 348 bp on 5 Nov, up 16 bp on the day, so credit has started to react.
chat.tip: Separate the base rate from the credit spread.
